NAME

acip_packet_plan_t

SYNOPSIS

buffer_domain_t * domain
Borrowed control reserve for handshake/error traffic; NULL otherwise.

Detailed Description

A borrowed packet description. Neither the vector array nor its bytes are owned. Keep both alive and immutable through encryption or synchronous delivery. Async delivery must copy/retain them before returning (platform_event_stream_write does). Serialize planning and encryption with other sends using the same crypto context.
